description: This file defines the frontend structure and styling for a web-based database viewer application. It contains HTML markup, embedded CSS styles for layout and appearance, and JavaScript code for dynamic interaction such as loading database lists, tables, and data via API calls, as well as managing UI state.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list, loading tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display data in table format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
